_meta.source: Adam 01: German v2 (Elias->Ilyas; 'wunderten sich' removed, H55). Only complete verse quoted: al-A'raf 7:23.

s01: Shhh… Noah, Ilyas… do you know who the very first human in the whole world was? Tonight I will tell you. Come, snuggle in.
s02: Every night I tell you the story of a prophet, and we start right at the beginning: with the Prophet Adam, peace be upon him.
s03: A very, very long time ago, before there was any human at all, Allah said to the angels: I will place a successor on the earth.
s04: The angels asked Allah about it. And Allah said: I know what you do not know.
s05: Then Allah created Adam from clay, from the earth. He shaped him with His hands and breathed into him of His spirit. And so Adam came alive: the very first human.
s06: Grandma, Grandma! Could Adam already talk?
s07: Oh yes, Ilyas. Allah taught Adam the names of all things, of everything Allah had created.
s08: Then Allah said to the angels: Tell Me their names. The angels answered humbly: Glory be to You, we know only what You have taught us.
s09: Then Allah said: O Adam, tell them their names. And Adam told them all, one after another.
s10: Then Allah commanded the angels: Prostrate to Adam. That was an honour for Adam, because Allah commanded it. We humans prostrate only to Allah.
s11: And all the angels prostrated… all of them… except one: Iblis.
s12: Iblis was not an angel; he was one of the jinn. He was arrogant and said: I am better than him. You created me from fire and him from clay.
s13: Because Iblis was so proud and did not obey Allah, he was sent away. From that day on he became the enemy of humans. We also call him Shaytan.
s14: Allah let Adam and his wife live in Paradise. It was very beautiful, and they could eat whatever they wished. Only one thing Allah had forbidden: Do not come near this tree.
s15: But Shaytan secretly whispered to them. He said the tree would make them angels or let them live forever. He even swore that he was a sincere adviser to them. But that was a lie.
s16: What do you think? Did they listen to him?
s17: Yes, they ate from the tree. Then their nakedness became visible to them, and they quickly covered themselves with leaves of the Garden. They knew they had done something wrong.
s18: And do you know what they did then? They did not say: It was not my fault. No, they repented with all their hearts, and Allah tells us about them in the Qur’an: “They said, ‘Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.’”
s19: And Allah, the Most Forgiving, the Most Merciful, accepted their repentance and forgave them.
s20: Then Allah sent them down to the earth and promised: I will send you guidance. Whoever follows it will have no fear and will not grieve.
s21: And so Adam became the first human on earth, and the first prophet.
s22: Noah? Ilyas? They are already asleep.
s23: Sleep well, my little stars, and remember: arrogance is bad, like with Iblis. But when we make a mistake, we honestly say: I am sorry, and we ask Allah for forgiveness, for Allah loves to forgive.
s24: Tomorrow I will tell you about the Prophet Idris, whom Allah raised to a high place. Good night.
